title: Pin test stops at dict-write + render; the stale-save half (typed value -> save persists NEW contact) is never driven
detail: The issue's core harm was Save persisting the ORIGINAL contact with a success toast (correction_cycles burned). This pin never dispatches UserSavedRefcheckEdit, and the existing save tests assert only inflight/saving flags, not that the request carries the typed values.
recommended_fix: Extend the pin: after simulate.input, dispatch UserSavedRefcheckEdit("rc-1") via simulate.message and assert the edit entry keeps the typed values and saving flips True; ideally assert the dispatched request payload carries them.
